name: RRP Lead Paint Containment - Siding
intent: EPA RRP containment for pre-1978 lead paint on siding. Setup, wet method, teardown.
doctrine: EPA RRP (40 CFR 745) containment for siding. Larger area than trim so setup/teardown times are longer (120/90 min vs 90/60 for trim). RRP cleanup is SF-based — HEPA vacuum and wipe verification.
